messages:
Maya: Arbiter requests quick perf/W + throughput sweep next Tue. Scope: kernel tune variants, fp16 vs int8 probes, thermal snapshots. They want publishable aggregated numbers if uplift is solid.

Ajay: I can run the matrix on their dev nodes. Proposed workloads: interactive (batch=1, seq=1024) and throughput (batch=16, seq=256).

Linh: I'll add telemetry hooks and the S3 uploader. Need a scrub step for any request payloads.

Maya: Acceptance: p99 < 200ms for batch=1 and perf/W >= 10% vs our health-checked baseline to consider public mention.

Ajay: Run plan: stock-kernel+fp16 (baseline), tuned-kernel+fp16, tuned-kernel+int8. Cold-start 3 iters, steady 8-10 iters. Measure power@1s, die temp, batcher stats, KV hit rates.

Diego: Arbiter sent a short addendum permitting aggregated perf/W publication and logo use pending legal review. I'll push for sign-off today.

bench-bot: Run queued: id=arbiter-1771234567-01. Upload manifest to s3://redwood-bench/arbiter/manifests/run-1771234567.json. Estimated 3.5h per config.

Linh: Scrub example I will use: jq 'del(.inputs,.user_id,.session_meta)' run_output.json > run_output.scrub.json. Will include pprof and aggregated metrics only.

Maya: Owners list: Ajay=kernels & run scripts, Linh=telemetry & uploader, Diego=legal. Eva not in thread but we'll loop in marketing if numbers look good.

Ajay: I'll drop the first run script in branch arbiter-bench by EOD and ping here.

Maya: Cool. Reconvene in-thread after steady-state for a 1-paragraph summary + a tiny table of perf/W deltas. :thumbsup:
